title: Infrastructure as code: secrets in the repository and reviewing the plan

videos.script: Lesson 1 made a bucket public with one request. Nobody saw it coming. {{request}} Written as code, the same mistake is a line in a file. And a file can be read before it does anything. {{file}} This lesson reads it three ways. First the plan, which says what AWS will be asked to do. {{plan}} You will watch the plan hide the policy, and then show it. {{scanner}} Then a scanner, which checks every resource against hundreds of rules. Two of its eight findings matter. The rest are questions. {{secrets}} Then the two places this kind of code leaks. A key removed from the files is still in the history. {{history}} And a password hidden on the screen is written in clear in the state file. {{state}} By the end, you can review a change before it exists, and say where its secrets went. {{end}}
